messages:
Lena (Hiring Manager): New engineering manager offer accepted for May start. Can People Ops/DevEx produce a single-page "manager quickstart" for the offer packet: day-by-day first-week checklist, who-to-contact shortcuts, a 1:1 agenda snippet, and three short 30/60/90 outcome lines? Need something recruiters can paste.

Priya: Yep, can do. I'll keep it <1 page, copy-paste friendly. Drafting now — will include owners and a short headcount sync note for Finance.

Jordan (IT): Quick heads-up: manager-class laptop procurement is ~3 business days. If start date is tight we can provide a temporary managed VM and ship hardware later. Need full legal name + personal email to pre-create SSO.

Sam (DevEx): I'll add two CLI snippets for repo invites + CI tokens and note that deploy perms are ramped over 30 days (read -> merge -> deploy). I can also be infra contact week 1.

Diego (Finance): Please add a line suggesting a 30-min headcount & budget sync in week 2. I can supply the template.

Priya: Draft (single-block, paste-ready):

```
Welcome blurb (paste into offer):
Welcome to Redwood! On Day 1 you'll have a 30-minute orientation with your hiring manager, brief team intros, and immediate access steps for code, CI, and monitoring. We'll share a concise 10-day onboarding sprint and a draft 30/60/90 within the first 10 days to align expectations.

Compact day-by-day checklist (owners):
Pre-start (before Day 1):
- Complete HR e-signs & benefits enrollment (People Ops)
- Confirm laptop shipment or enable managed VM (IT)
- Pre-invite to Slack, Google Workspace, Confluence (People Ops)

Day 1 AM:
- 30m orientation with hiring manager: role scope + top priorities (Manager)
- 15m team intro round (Manager)
- Laptop SSO, MFA, VPN certs (IT)

Day 1 PM:
- Access checklist: GitHub org, JIRA, CI tokens, Datadog dashboards, Redwood Console (DevEx/IT)
- Schedule weekly 1:1s, send first 1:1 agenda (Manager)

Days 2-5 (first week focus):
- Product & architecture walkthroughs (Tech Leads)
- 1:1s with direct reports + skip-level intro (Manager)
- Incident runbook walkthrough & paging demo (Eng-SRE)
- Complete mandatory security training (Security)
- Quick win: identify one immediate blocker to unblock (Manager/New Hire)

By Day 10:
- Share draft 30/60/90 and top 3 priorities (Manager/New Hire)
- Assign mentor/buddy and escalation contacts (Manager)

30/60/90 (one-line each, paste-ready):
- 30d: Understand team scope, run recurring 1:1s, and close onboarding gaps.
- 60d: Deliver a committed milestone and propose one operational improvement.
- 90d: Lead next-quarter planning and present hiring/resource requests to Finance.

One-page 1:1 agenda (first meeting):
- Personal check-in (5m), role expectations & immediate priorities (10m), blockers & support (10m), next steps & cadence (5m).

Who to ping (fast):
- IT (Jordan): laptop / SSO / VPN
- DevEx (Sam): repo invites, CI tokens, local dev bootstrap, deploy ramp
- People Ops (Nina): benefits, scheduling, onboarding tasks
- Finance (Diego): headcount & budget syncs
- Eng-SRE: on-call rota & paging runbook
- Security: trainings & compliance questions

Quick CLI snippets (for DevEx):
- Request GitHub invite: `devex request-invite --email <email> --team eng-managers`
- Request CI token: `devex request-token --service=ci --scope=repo`
- Expedite laptop/VM: `it-setup-bot create --type manager --priority high --name "Full Name"`
```

Priya: I'll publish this to Confluence and post the link here when ready. Planning to drop final copy by EOD.

Nina (People Ops): Lena, send start date + legal name and I'll kick off HR + IT flows.

Jordan (IT): Noted. If start date <3 days let us know and I'll set up a managed VM and label shipped hardware as pending.

Sam (DevEx): I'll volunteer to be the infra buddy week 1 and will attach the CLI snippets to Confluence.

Diego (Finance): I'll add the headcount sync template to the Confluence bundle.

onboard-bot: IT ticket created #IT-120211 for manager hardware/VM provisioning (ETA: 3 business days).

Lena (Hiring Manager): This is great, thanks all  I'll send the legal name + start date this afternoon.
